name: LANKO 752 Bondit
paste:
LANKO 752 BONDIT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: LANKO 752 Bondit, April 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/lanko-752-bondit.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide LANKO 752 Bondit where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. LANKO 752 Bondit is a P.V.A. based emulsion for use as a mortar additive, primer and sealer. LANKO 752 Bondit increases the adhesion, flexibility, tensile strength and impact resistance of mortars. Also suitable for bonding timber to timber.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Mixed with water and applied to concrete surfaces for priming, dustproofing and sealing. As an additive to sand/cement for concrete patching applications. As an additive in sand/cement for rendering applications. As an additive in mortars for tiling over concrete, render, blockwork and rendered brickwork surfaces. As a slurry into neat cement for bonding new sand/cement toppings onto concrete surfaces. For bonding timber onto timber.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. LANKO 752 Bondit
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: PVA Additive for strenghtening cement based products
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very economical
    - Improves flexural and compressive strengths of the mortars
    - Increases adhesion, and tensile strength Ideal for bonding timber to timber
2.4 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5 L and 20 L drums
    - Shelf life: 12 months
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 4°C - 35°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Consumption. Joinery: Approximately 3.5m²/L when used neat, depending upon surface porosity and site conditions. Priming: 6-8m²/L when diluted with water and applied with a brush or roller. Mortar Addition: Approximately 750 mL to 1L of LANKO 752 Bondit with required water to each 20 kg of sand/cement mix.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not use LANKO 752 Bondit in temperatures above 40ºC and below 5ºC.
    - Do not use LANKO 752 Bondit in permanently wet or damp areas such as swimming pools and spas. In these types of installations, use Davco Lanko 751 Lankolatex.
    - LANKO 752 Bondit is not recommended for the bonding of plastic or rubber.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - Do not use LANKO 752 Bondit in temperatures above 40ºC and below 5ºC.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: LANKO 752 Bondit, April 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/lanko-752-bondit.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Lanko 752 Bondit, version 05/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/Lanko%20752%20Bondit.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS LANKO 752 Bondit, version 08/07/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sds-lanko-752-bondit.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
